This repository implements a fast, real-time object detection system for CCTV surveillance using the YOLOv5n6 model. It achieves high processing speeds by performing inference on low-resolution frames and then drawing the detection results onto high-resolution video streams, all accessible through an interactive Gradio interface.

PriceGhost is a self-hosted price tracking application designed to monitor product prices from any website. It employs a unique multi-strategy extraction system, including JSON-LD, site-specific scrapers, generic CSS, and AI analysis, to accurately determine product prices. Users are presented with a Price Voting Modal to confirm the correct price, ensuring accurate tracking and preventing common price tracking errors.

LemonSees is an agentless Security Operations Center (SOC) and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform designed for L1/L2/L3 analysts. It leverages SSH connections as the sole means of interaction, eliminating the need for any server-side installations, and provides a comprehensive suite of tools for monitoring, threat intelligence, and incident response directly from a Windows desktop application.
